OpenAI Compatibility

Example Cloud's API is OpenAI-compatible: point any OpenAI client at our base URL and use your Example Cloud API key.

Configuring OpenAI to use Example Cloud's API

Set the base URL to https://api.example-cloud.dev/openai/v1 and the key to EXAMPLE_API_KEY.

import os
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI(
    api_key=os.environ.get("EXAMPLE_API_KEY"),
    base_url="https://api.example-cloud.dev/openai/v1",
)
response = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="llama-4-scout-17b",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Hello"}],
)
curl https://api.example-cloud.dev/openai/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $EXAMPLE_API_KEY" \
  -d '{"model": "qwen3-32b", "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Hi"}]}'

List the models your key can use with GET https://api.example-cloud.dev/openai/v1/models.
